My initial analysis of the reference images confirms that the visual evidence is most consistent with Die_Back. The reference image for Die_Back (`CyberVisionAg/Prepared_Dataset/Mango_Leaf/Die_Back/merged/Mango_Leaf_14.jpg`) shows an almost identical state of decay. In contrast, the reference images for Anthracnose show distinct lesions, Sooty_Mould shows black fungal growth, and Powdery_Mildew shows characteristic white, powdery spots. None of these match the test image. Therefore, the diagnosis of Die_Back is made with high confidence.
